title: A whole new mall world!
content: This most recent mall world was, in the dream, a college dormitory. An expensive one. A private room cost $1m for 4 years. It was truly bizarre. Escape was not possible or nearly impossible and you’d immediately become under pursuit should you escape. The dorms were separated at various ends of corridors similarly to how department stores are placed- and the inner sections were stores and food courts. It was confusing to navigate and I kept feeling like I wasn’t supposed to be there but I wasn’t allowed to leave either. An old boyfriend and I got to hang out and chat in a friendly manner. I remember telling him the dorms were like a casino and designed so we couldn’t leave. Getting out required some Portal video game like techniques and lots of stair cases and constantly trying to ditch a tail.
